text: むう…　ゆめを　みてた　ようじゃ

patterns.name: 〜ようだ
patterns.explanation: ようだ after a statement means 'it looks like'; じゃ is the old-man way of saying だ. みてた ようじゃ = 'it seems I was seeing (a dream)'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている says the action is going on; みていた is its past, and みてた is the shortened spoken form. ゆめを みてた = 'was dreaming'.
